item.title: perf(ci): keep the real-Gateway UI E2E lane on Blacksmith in hybrid mode
item.summary: perf(ci): keep the real-Gateway UI E2E lane on Blacksmith in hybrid mode `checks-ui-e2e-real-gateway` folded `hybrid` into the `github` breaker clause instead of taking the attempt-gated route its sibling `checks-ui-e2e` uses, so it was the only Chromium lane pinned to hosted capacity on attempt 1. Measured across 46 canonical main runs it averaged 205s (max 225s) against a 150-190s plateau, making it the run's slowest job whenever the compact Node matrix behaved. Route it like `checks-ui-e2e`: Blacksmith 16-vCPU on attempt 1, hosted on rerun, manual dispatch, fork, and same-repo PR retry. Cache inputs stay on the shared pnpm store for both backends, matching the sibling lane. The guard now derives both Chromium lanes' `runs-on` from one pinned template so a hosted-only divergence cannot return unnoticed; mutation-checked by reverting the workflow clause (2 failures).
